mapper.sql: w.work_order_id, w.production_plan_id, w.product_item_id, w.bom_version_id, w.routing_revision_id, w.ordered_qty, w.product_unit_code, w.status, w.created_at, w.created_by, w.started_at, w.started_by, w.cancelled_at, w.cancelled_by, w.completed_at, w.completed_by, w.inspection_target_qty, i.item_code AS product_code, i.item_name AS product_name, b.bom_code, bv.version_no AS bom_version_no, r.routing_code, rv.revision_no AS routing_revision_no

FROM work_order w JOIN item i ON i.item_id = w.product_item_id JOIN bom_version bv ON bv.bom_version_id = w.bom_version_id JOIN bom b ON b.bom_id = bv.bom_id JOIN routing_revision rv ON rv.routing_revision_id = w.routing_revision_id JOIN routing r ON r.routing_id = rv.routing_id
mapper.select: SELECT work_order_id, production_plan_id, product_item_id, bom_version_id, routing_revision_id, ordered_qty, product_unit_code, status FROM work_order WHERE work_order_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.production_plan_id, p.product_item_id, p.planned_qty, p.planned_date, i.item_code AS product_code, i.item_name AS product_name, i.unit_code FROM production_plan p JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.product_item_id ORDER BY p.production_plan_id DESC
SELECT production_plan_id, product_item_id, planned_qty, planned_date FROM production_plan WHERE production_plan_id = #{planId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT routing_revision_id, routing_id, revision_no, first_used_at FROM routing_revision WHERE routing_revision_id = #{revisionId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT v.bom_version_id, b.bom_code, v.version_no, v.base_qty, v.product_unit_code, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bom_component c WHERE c.bom_version_id = v.bom_version_id) AS component_count FROM bom b JOIN bom_version v ON v.bom_id = b.bom_id WHERE b.product_item_id = #{productId} ORDER BY b.bom_id DESC, v.version_no DESC

SELECT v.routing_revision_id, r.routing_code, v.revision_no, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM routing_step s WHERE s.routing_revision_id = v.routing_revision_id) AS step_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM routing_step s JOIN manufacturing_process p ON p.process_id = s.process_id WHERE s.routing_revision_id = v.routing_revision_id AND p.is_active = 0) AS inactive_process_count FROM routing r JOIN routing_revision v ON v.routing_id = r.routing_id WHERE r.product_item_id = #{productId} ORDER BY r.routing_id DESC, v.revision_no DESC

SELECT p.planned_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.ordered_qty),0) FROM work_order w WHERE w.production_plan_id=p.production_plan_id) AS allocated_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.ordered_qty),0) FROM work_order w WHERE w.production_plan_id=p.production_plan_id AND w.status='CANCELLED') AS cancelled_qty FROM production_plan p WHERE p.production_plan_id=#{planId}

SELECT p.production_result_id,p.finished_lot_id,p.produced_qty,p.good_qty,p.defect_qty,p.produced_at,p.worker_ref, f.work_order_id,f.lot_no FROM finished_goods_lot f JOIN production_result p ON p.finished_lot_id=f.finished_lot_id WHERE f.work_order_id=#{id} ORDER BY p.production_result_id DESC
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM finished_goods_lot WHERE work_order_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM material_consumption WHERE work_order_id=#{id})
mapper.update: UPDATE bom_version SET first_used_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE bom_version_id=#{versionId} AND first_used_at IS NULL
UPDATE routing_revision SET first_used_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE routing_revision_id=#{revisionId} AND first_used_at IS NULL
UPDATE work_order SET status='IN_PROGRESS', started_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), started_by=#{actor}, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE work_order_id=#{id} AND status='READY'
UPDATE work_order SET status='CANCELLED', cancelled_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), cancelled_by=#{actor}, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE work_order_id=#{id} AND status='READY'

UPDATE work_order SET status='COMPLETED',inspection_target_qty=#{targetQty}, completed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),completed_by=#{actor},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE work_order_id=#{id} AND status='IN_PROGRESS' AND inspection_target_qty IS NULL
